subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Novelty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Novelty"** means the quality of being new, original, or unusual. (नवीनता)

 
 
• **Example: **The** novelty** of the new gadget attracted many customers.
 
 
 
• **"Stagnation" **refers to the state of not flowing or moving, lack of activity, growth, or development. (स्थिरता)
 
 
• **Example: **The **stagnation** in the economy has led to a high unemployment rate.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'novelty' **is **'stagnation'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vintage** (पुराना): Denoting something of high quality, especially something from the past or of lasting interest.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a collection of vintage cars that are well-maintained.
 
 
 
• **Creation** (सृजन): The action or process of bringing something into existence.
 
 
• **Example: **The creation of the new art piece took several months.
 
 
 
• **Pursue** (पलान करना): Follow or chase (someone or something).
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
 
 

30:Td34,

The correct answer is: Option 1.&
